card.name: New Recruits
card.action: Discard one other card from your Hand if able, then +3 Cards.

designIntent: Make New Recruits a genuine hand-replenishment option rather than pure filtering.
Allow the Action to recover from a one-card Hand instead of being unusable there.
Preserve a discard requirement whenever another Hand card is available.
Use the higher card value to price the stronger Neutral effect and preserve a meaningful play-versus-value decision for Financiers.

starterDeckImpact.reason: All twelve recommended starter Decks contained New Recruits and were exactly 60 Deckbuilding Value before the cost increase.
starterDeckImpact.policy: Keep every starter at 30 cards and 60 Deckbuilding Value with minimal one-for-one substitutions; do not change the global 60-value construction limit.

authority: Update New Recruits cost and Action text in current-game authority.
Register this design record in current-development provenance.
digitalEngine: Permit New Recruits to be played with no other Hand card.
If another Hand card exists when the effect resolves, require one such card to be discarded before drawing.
If no other Hand card exists when the effect resolves, skip the discard and draw three cards.
Draw three rather than two in all successful resolutions.
starters: Keep all twelve recommended starter Decks at exactly 30 cards and 60 Deckbuilding Value.
Do not alter the global 60-value construction limit.
integrationRequirements.releaseBoundary: This is a v0.7.2 gameplay change. Published v0.7.1 artifacts remain immutable.
